text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> High error rate detected on inference-runtime pool 'redwood-prod-a' (kv-cache miss storm + tail latency). Paging oncall @maria. Alerts: 5xx spike, 99th latency > 2s, model fallback triggered for some requests. Link: https://alerts.redwood/INC-1769443210

maria: on it. acked the page. starting triage. @sam can you pull cpu/gpu and qps?

sam: grabbing metrics now. seeing a sudden jump in kv-cache miss rate at 16:02 UTC, throughput steady, batching queue depth up ~3x. nodes showing high GPU kernel retries on a subset.

sam: paste logs snippet:
```
[16:02:18] kvcache: miss_rate=0.78, eviction_rate=0.02
[16:02:22] batcher: queue_ms=420, avg_batch_size=24
[16:02:25] runtime: quant_select: fallback_to_fp16=True, kernel_retries=5
```

maria: thanks. symptoms look like kvcache missstorm compounding batching -> higher latency -> more cache churn. notifying product.

devin: jumping in. recent rollout (2026-03-15) added an aggressive allocation for quantized kernels that changes shard ordering — could be related. I'm going to temporarily disable auto-batching and force smaller batch sizes for the affected pool. Also propose bumping kvcache TTL to reduce churn.

jordan: cc'ing support: list of customers currently seeing errors: fin-app-prod, search-ox. Support contacted them with status page link.

maria: execute mitigations in this order: 1) disable batching autoscale policy for pool 12 2) flush kvcache on pool 12 3) pin model variant to non-quantized for a small % (canary) while we observe. Who will apply?

devin: I'll do 1 and 3. sam, can you handle the cache flush (we may need to throttle flush to avoid stampede)?

sam: flushing in rate-limited mode now with this command:
```
redwoodctl cache flush --pool=redwood-prod-a --rate=10/s --confirm
```
Applying change to autoscaling/batching: `redwoodctl runtime set-batching --pool=redwood-prod-a --mode=manual --max-batch-size=8`


[~6 min later]

sam: flush complete, batching limits applied. first 2 min post-change: error rate down 60%, p99 latency dropping from 2.1s -> 720ms.

maria: nice. devin, start canary pin to unquantized for 5% traffic. keep telemetry on.

devin: canary started: `pin_model_variant --pool=redwood-prod-a --variant=fp16-safe --percent=5`
Observed initial canary success. no kernel retries on canary VMs.

irene: product note: impacted customers flagged as high. support provided ETA ~45m for mitigation; asked if we can offer credits. I'll coordinate comms once we have stable numbers.

maria: we'll keep the pool in this degraded config for now. next steps: capture full logs, start post-incident review. schedule PM and postmortem.

jordan: suggested postmortem attendees: devin (runtime), sam (sre), maria (oncall), irene (product), ops-runbook. proposed time: 2026-03-17 10:00 UTC. ok?

devin: ok for me. I'll prepare a short diff of the 2026-03-15 rollout that touched quant kernel selection.

sam: I'll export metrics and a flamegraph for the batching queue.

maria: action items now (assignments inline):
- A1: root-cause hypothesis doc + evidence — owner: devin — due: 2026-03-18
- A2: automated kvcache warmup test in CI (simulate missstorm) — owner: sam — due: 2026-03-25
- A3: add pre-rollout perf gate for quant-selection (perf + kv miss sim) — owner: devin + eng-ml — due: 2026-04-01
- A4: update runbook for emergency cache flush & ratelimit steps — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-20
- A5: customer comms draft + credits recommendation — owner: irene — due: 2026-03-18

maria: recording these in the incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC-1769443210
Please add PR links as you create fixes.

[~40m after initial page]

sam: monitoring shows steady state: p99 ~680ms, error rate near baseline. batching queue back to normal depth, kvcache miss rate stabilized at 0.12.

imaria (typo recovery): sorry, meant maria.

maria: no worries :) Good to hand off. Oncall rotation change at 18:00 UTC; I'll leave a short checklist in the incident thread and hand to next oncall @jordan.

jordan: taking handoff. I'll keep the mitigations in place until postmortem and remediation tasks start. I'll also open a tracking ticket in our sprint board and link the incident.

devin: follow-up technical note: suspected interplay of quant kernel selection + shard ordering caused objects to miss hot cache key ranges under certain batch-size patterns. early patch: revert ordering change and add a canary that validates kvcache hit-rate under synthetic traffic.

irene: thanks everyone. I'll notify key customers of resolution and next steps tomorrow after postmortem.

maria: closing live mitigation. marking incident as 'mitigated' in pager and scheduling postmortem for 10:00 UTC tomorrow. please ensure owners created tickets. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-1769443210 status -> Mitigated. Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-17 10:00 UTC. Links: incident page, runbook, postmortem doc placeholder.

maria: final note — add an alert that triggers when kvcache miss_rate > 0.5 AND avg_batch_size > 16 for > 1m. that should catch similar regressions earlier. (owner: sam)

sam: will add alert rule and test.
